note: What was seen in the evidence files, not what Premiere allows. present/of = objects that had the path / objects of the class.

AudioClip.purpose: audio clip instance: Source, ClipID, In/OutPoint, SecondaryContents, channel layout

AudioClipTrackItem.purpose: audio item on a track: Start/End, component chain, `<ID>` GUID

AudioCompileSettings.purpose: audio side of a compile setting

AudioComponentParam.purpose: audio effect parameter: float (Level, Balance, Volume) or bool (Mute, Bypass)

AudioSequenceSource.purpose: Clip source → Sequence (a sequence used as a clip), audio

AudioSettings.purpose: audio settings shell owned by project/compile settings

AudioTrackInlet.purpose: master inlet listing the source tracks

AudioTransitionTrackItem.purpose: audio fade or crossfade on a track (`TransitionItems`, `HeadTransition`/`TailTransition`)

ClipChannelGroupVectorSerializer.purpose: MasterClip audio channel groups (empty if no audio)

ClipLoggingInfo.purpose: ClipName, media in/out, frame rate, timecode format

CompileSettings.purpose: export/compile presets (movie, still, audio, custom, video preview)

DataStream.purpose: stream of the synthetic transcript Media

FileProjectItem.purpose: project item for a non-media file (e.g. a .txt)

Link.purpose: ties the linked A/V track items

Marker.purpose: one marker: a DVAMarker JSON string (name, comment, type, start time, colour)

Markers.purpose: marker list of a master clip (empty until a marker is added) or a sequence

MasterClip.purpose: clip identity: Clips list, logging, channel map

Media.purpose: one file on disk: paths, importer, streams

SecondaryContent.purpose: per-channel ref from an AudioClip to its source

SubClip.purpose: track item → (MasterClip, Clip); `Name` shown on the timeline

VideoClip.purpose: video clip instance: Source, ClipID, In/OutPoint, label

VideoClipTrackItem.purpose: video item on a track: Start/End, component chain

VideoCompileSettings.purpose: video side of a compile setting

VideoComponentChain.purpose: video effect stack (track item or track group)

VideoComponentParam.purpose: video effect parameter: float, bool, enum or colour (Scale, Rotation, Opacity, Skew, …)

VideoSequenceSource.purpose: Clip source → Sequence (a sequence used as a clip), video

VideoSettings.purpose: video settings shell owned by project/compile settings

VideoStream.purpose: duration, fps, size, codec FourCC, alpha
